lines.text: The east gallery. Every painting is still wet.
Ah, visitors! Admire my collection. Every clue on that canvas is genuine. Mostly.
See the 🎭 clues? Five of them. Three are fakes. The other two are telling the truth.
So we don't trust any 🎭 clue. We solve those rows from the columns. If a row lights up, it was honest.
And if it's filled right but stays dark, it's a forgery. Then we tap 🔍 Call out and point at it. Guess wrong and it hurts us.
